purpose: Held-out historical replay tasks for testing the line-ranged source pointer and related-use coverage changes on work that did not inform Engram development
runner_note: No collection adapter targets this suite yet. scripts/run_real_repo_followup.py is bound to real-repo-v2; adapt or generalize it, then freeze a manifest, before any collection.
result_claims: None. No coding-agent attempt has been run against this suite; grader calibration is not an agent outcome.

selection.method: Historical fix commits on the operator repositories' main branches (agi-backend-rust origin/main, agents origin/main) with a behavioral contract testable offline, roughly one to five source files, no later revert found on main as of 2026-10-04, and no overlap with real-repo-v1 or real-repo-v2 tasks.
excluded: Every real-repo-v1 and real-repo-v2 task and its related variant.

Platform and mobile candidates: the prepared platform dependency tree under /tmp was found partially purged on 2026-10-04 and mobile needs Android/Gradle tooling, so neither could be calibrated locally.
selection.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm that none of these fixes, their sessions or their code areas informed Engram development or tuning. The drafting agent read the reference diffs to build graders; the coding agents under test never see them.

roadmap_features.line_ranged_pointers: Relevant code sits inside a source file larger than the 256 KB Read limit observed in the 2026-09-25 follow-up.
roadmap_features.related_use_cue: A correct fix must reach several call sites or consumers of one definition or contract.

tasks.title: Deliver the effect-check note only when LoopGuard enforces
tasks.large_file_facts: At base, src/services/action_engine.rs is 800,915 bytes (19,181 lines) and the fix site is near line 1,787; tests/http_contract.rs is 545,468 bytes and an existing test there encodes the old every-mode delivery.
acceptance: LOOPGUARD_MODE=shadow and off send no [effect-check] note to the model for a dead tap.
Shadow and off record no note in stored step prompts.
Enforce still delivers the note with its wording, and stays silent when the screen moved.
Shadow LoopGuard still scores a repeated tap on an unchanged screen as a screen-confirmed inject, and recorded steps keep screen fingerprints.
environment: Calibrated with Homebrew Rust 1.96.0, offline and locked, against loopback mock model servers. No database, Redis or live model.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: A line-ranged pointer to the note's delivery span and to the existing contract test lets the agent read two spans instead of two files above the Read limit.
tasks.provenance: Historical squash merge on main (cut 0.59.4). Shares its base commit with h05.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

review_notes: The shadow-scoring check observes LoopGuard through its INFO log line loopguard_shadow (rung inject) and the per-step screen_fingerprint field. Both are existing internal observables, not part of a public API.

tasks.title: Tag model-failure and reaction analytics with the frozen origin
tasks.large_file_facts: At base, src/services/action_engine.rs is 666,541 bytes (16,234 lines); the failure emit is near line 1,270 and its event builder near line 8,542.
acceptance: A first-step model failure carries the request origin, normalized as session creation would; values creation drops stay absent.
A failure on an existing session carries its frozen stamp, including no origin, regardless of the request.
Reaction user_feedback event, user_feedback signal and task_completed/task_failed signal carry the session origin; origin-less sessions omit the key.
Existing step and session_end origin stamping is unchanged.
environment: Calibrated with Homebrew Rust 1.96.0, offline and locked; loopback mock model and Raindrop bridge. No database, Redis or live model.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: A related-use cue from the existing origin stamping to the other analytics emitters (failure events in the engine, feedback in the reactions route) prevents a one-emitter fix.
tasks.provenance: Historical commit on a feature branch later merged to main; a follow-up to the 0.46.0 entry-door tagging.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

review_notes: The prompt names the two record families that lack origin; it does not name files or functions.
Model-failure task_failed and error signals are not graded for origin (the historical fix tags only the failure event).

tasks.title: Default scheme-less navigation targets to https on every agent path
acceptance: Every navigation path (server first navigation, CDP base goto action, and the claude, qwen, qwen-1 and cua goto handlers) defaults scheme-less targets to https after trimming whitespace.
Host:port and host/path forms count as scheme-less.
Already-schemed targets (http, https, file, chrome, about:blank, data:) are unchanged.
candidate_validation_commands: python3 -m py_compile src/agi_agents/framework/agent_server_state.py src/agi_agents/framework/base/cdp_agent.py src/agi_agents/agi_0_claude/tools.py src/agi_agents/agi_0_qwen/tools.py src/agi_agents/agi_1_qwen/tools.py src/agi_agents/agi_0_cua/parser.py
environment: Python standard-library grader (calibrated with Python 3.14.7) that imports the candidate's real modules with third-party packages stubbed. No dependency installation, browser, network or subprocess.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: A related-use cue across the sibling goto handlers and shared navigation paths turns a one-agent fix into a six-path fix.
tasks.provenance: Historical squash merge on main (#581). The historical change touched nine files (six one-line call-site edits, a new helper, its export and a test), above the suite's usual five-file guideline because the task is about breadth of call sites.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

review_notes: The prompt names the categories of navigation path so the contract is gradable; this makes the sites easier to enumerate than a vaguer prompt would.
A candidate importing a third-party package absent from the grader stubs fails to load and is scored as a failure; review such a result by hand.

tasks.title: Resolve Play subscription base-plan product ids at every plan lookup
acceptance: Purchase, renewal and uncancellation events with <subscription>:<base_plan> ids update and grant the mapped plan.
Product changes switch to the plan of the suffixed new_product_id.
Unrecorded-row expiration, cancellation and billing-issue events keep retrying for mapped products; unmapped products are still acknowledged.
Plain subscription ids, credit packs and unmapped subscriptions behave as before.
environment: Python standard-library grader (calibrated with Python 3.14.7). Real service and repository code; recording fakes for state; bounded in-memory query emulation for plan lookups. No DATABASE_URL, database, network or subprocess.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: A related-use cue from the plan lookup to its three callers (lifecycle grant, product change, permanent-missing-row decision) prevents a fix that only repairs purchases.
tasks.provenance: Historical commit on main (API-265 review finding).

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

review_notes: The prompt lists the three event families as acceptance criteria, which maps closely to the three lookups. Removing the list would strengthen the related-use test but leave the missing-row retry rule underspecified; decide before freezing.
Repository fixes that use SQL functions outside the emulation (lower, upper, trim, coalesce, split_part) fail and need manual review.

tasks.title: Truncate human-response prompt fields on character boundaries
acceptance: No panic for multi-byte text in any prompt field or transcript entry.
Limits count characters; text within a limit is whole; longer text keeps the longest leading prefix before the existing suffix.
environment: Calibrated with Homebrew Rust 1.96.0, offline and locked. Pure function tests through the public prompt builder; no services.
tasks.engram_hypothesis: Small control in a 19 KB file (18,835 bytes at base): context should add little, and overhead is visible.
tasks.provenance: Historical squash merge on main (GOD-2608). Shares its base commit with h01.

grader.scope: Run after coding, outside the editable agent workspace; calibration is not an agent outcome.

review_notes: The truncation helper has nine call sites in the file; the transcript case catches a fix limited to the four top-level fields.

runtime_note: Pin the model route, effort, tools, limits and Engram build in a frozen manifest when the collection adapter exists. Reuse the v2 isolation rules: synthetic one-commit fixtures, fresh source-only snapshots, no Engram access in Off.
attempt_retention: When collected, retain every attempt, including failures, timeouts and infrastructure errors; never replace an attempt.
